description: Go source file for Kubernetes API extensions client, defining the client interface and functions to create and configure the client for interacting with CustomResourceDefinitions in the apiextensions.k8s.io group.

classes.name: ApiextensionsV1Client
classes.description: Client implementation for interacting with the apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 API group, providing methods to access CustomResourceDefinitions and manage REST configuration.

methods.name: CustomResourceDefinitions
methods.description: Returns an interface to manage CustomResourceDefinitions.

methods.name: NewForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new client using the provided REST configuration.

methods.name: NewForConfigAndClient
methods.description: Creates a new client with the provided REST configuration and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewForConfigOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new client or panics if configuration is invalid.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new client with the given REST interface.

methods.name: RESTClient
methods.description: Returns the underlying REST client used for communication.
